lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dawn breaks over the Delaware River. Jackie and Frankie stand at the edge[cite: 32].

lines.speaker: FRANKIE
lines.text: I did it for us, Jackie. Please[cite: 33, 34]...

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Shots ring out. Frankie falls, whispering his final words[cite: 37].
